designationHistory.indexText: Establishment of the Bears Ears National Monument

sources.name: American Presidency Project: Proclamation 9558—Establishment of the Bears Ears National Monument, December 28, 2016

review.note: Proclamation 9558, 82 FR 1139, signed 2016-12-28; FR API and APP agree on number, date and President.

designationHistory.indexText: Modifying the Bears Ears National Monument

sources.name: American Presidency Project: Proclamation 9681—Modifying the Bears Ears National Monument, December 04, 2017

review.note: Proclamation 9681, 82 FR 58081, signed 2017-12-04; FR API and APP agree on number, date and President. Reduced the monument to about 201,876 acres in two units (Indian Creek, Shash Jaa).

designationHistory.indexText: Restored and expanded the monument's boundaries (Proclamation 10285): about 1.36 million acres, the 2016 lands plus about 11,200 acres added in 2017

sources.name: American Presidency Project: Proclamation 10285—Bears Ears National Monument, October 08, 2021

review.note: Proclamation 10285, 86 FR 57321, signed 2021-10-08; FR API and APP agree on number, date and President. Title names the monument only; operative text reserves the lands of the monument as of Dec. 3, 2017 plus the ~11,200 acres added by Proclamation 9681, about 1.36 million acres.

designationHistory.indexText: Modifying the Bears Ears National Monument

sources.name: American Presidency Project: Proclamation 11043—Modifying the Bears Ears National Monument, July 13, 2026

review.note: Proclamation 11043, 91 FR 45169, signed 2026-07-13; FR API and APP agree on number, date and President. Post-cutoff proclamation verified on federalregister.gov and govinfo (published July 17, 2026): reduced the monument to about 121,096 acres in the Indian Creek and Shash Jaa units.
